title: Effect of Different Levels of Zinc and Compost on Yield and Yield Components of Wheat
authors: Dawar, K., Ali, W., Bibi, H., Mian, I.A., Ahmad, M.A., Hussain, M.B., Ali, M., Ali, S., Fahad, S., Rehman, S.u., Datta, R., Syed, A., Danish, S.
note: This paper reports yield and yield components (plant height, tillers/m2, spikes/m2, spike length, 1000-grain weight, biological yield, grain yield) and soil properties, but does NOT report grain or tissue Zn concentration. Therefore no Zn concentration observations can be extracted for the Hui 2023 meta-analysis. Variety: Shahkar-2013, Swabi ARS, Rabi 2015 and 2016, RCB 3 reps, 4 Zn levels (0, 2.5, 5.0, 10.0 kg/ha) x 3 compost levels (0, 5, 10 t/ha).
